sentences.text: Heard Mr. Bilal Ahmed, learned counselfor the applicants and Mr. Chitrarth Kandpal, learned Brief Holder for the respondent no.1.
3. Mr. Bilal Ahmed, Advocate, submitted that the applicants are real brothers of the husband of the respondent no.2 - informant and there are chances of settlement between the parties.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent no.1 has sought three weeks' time to file counter affidavit, if any.
5. Notice is being issued to the respondent no.2.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Criminal Case No.22 of 2025 are stayed.
7. The applicants and the respondent no.2 are directed to appear in-person before this Court on 03.12.2025 at 10:30 a.m. (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
